title: project-LICHEN-worker6-trau: dead duplicate validation in protect_response else branch
description:
Commit c1f4690f added early validation at lines 974-979 for protect_response (request_kid length, from_piv validity, recipient_id match). The existing validation at lines 999-1006 inside the 'else (no PIV) branch now duplicates those checks:

- request_piv.is_empty() — caught by from_piv.is_none()
- request_piv.len() > PIV_MAX_LEN — caught by from_piv.is_none()
- request_kid != self.recipient_id() — duplicate of line 976
- OscoreSeqNum::from_piv(request_piv).map(...).unwrap() — safe now but unwrap() is fragile

The dead code should be removed; the early validation already covers all cases. The .unwrap() on line 1007 should be replaced with a safe access pattern (match or expect with message).
